name: hdbt_subtheme
description: Theme builder configuration for HDBT subtheme
author: Druid
@comment scripts: Every build, lint and format script below runs inside a disposable Node container via the sandbox command.

scripts.build: sandbox sh -c 'npm run format:js --loglevel=silent && npm run lint --loglevel=silent && node theme-builder.mjs'

@comment dependencies.svg-sprite > glob: ^13.0.0, dependency of @hdbt/theme-builder; drops deprecated glob@7 and inflight
